trap.label: provided that
trap.wrong: Provided of the road stays open, we will arrive.
trap.right: Provided that the road stays open, we will arrive.
trap.why: O brasileiro troca por “desde de/que”. Em inglês: provided (that) + oração no presente.

mcq.q: ___ the road stays open, we will arrive.
Had we ___ , we would have won.

opts: Provided it will rain, we stay.

fix.wrong: Provided it will rain, we stay.
Had we start earlier, we would have won.
fix.right: Had we started earlier, we would have won.

fix.wrong: Unless you don’t study, you won’t learn.
fix.right: Unless you study, you won’t learn.

rewrite.prompt: Use provided that: “We arrive if the road stays open.”
rewrite.answer: We will arrive provided that the road stays open.

rewrite.prompt: Inverta: “If we had started earlier, we would have won.”
rewrite.answer: Had we started earlier, we would have won.

rewrite.prompt: Use unless: “If you don’t study, you won’t learn.”
rewrite.answer: Unless you study, you won’t learn.
